Workshop objectives

The purpose of the workshop is for participants to develop a shared understanding of the:

1

Diversity of interests, areas of expertise, and relationships to the waterways of the CC-NVI project area

2

Waterway safety committee model and how it could apply in this region

3

Vision, mission, and direction for the CC-NVI waterway safety committee

Target outputAt the end of the workshop we will have a clear plan for establishing a WSC in early 2027.

The framing

A shared journey, grounded in understanding the waterway, recognizing the different vessels, knowledge, responsibilities, and capacities we each bring, and building the trust and relationships needed to navigate challenges, identify a shared direction, and paddle forward together.

The Fleet

distinct vessels, one shared waterway — coming together to manage it well

First Nations — nine canoes
FN aggregates
Agency
Industry — an open invitation

This is where your vessel would be — we welcome you to paddle alongside us.

Workshop Agenda

The agenda follows the waterway we are gathering to talk about, from Klemtu south to Comox. Travelling it together grounds each conversation in the place itself, and lets us build our relationships from there.

Scroll on the chart to travel the route, or choose any entry in the Ship’s Log. The chart is illustrative and the route is fictitious: the workshop itself meets at the Georgian Court Hotel in Vancouver.

All times are Pacific Time (Vancouver).

Start · 8:30 am coffeeNorth of Klemtu
Wed · 9:00 amWelcome to the gathering Klemtu

Ensure a shared understanding of meeting purpose, focus, and format

  • Welcoming remarks
  • Review workshop purpose and agenda
Wed · 9:30 amParticipant introductions Bella Bella

Ensure a shared understanding of participating organizations and what they bring to the group Objective 1

  • Who are you representing today? What places or marine activities are the reason you are here?
  • What strengths and limitations does your organization bring to this effort?
10:40 am · Coffee breakOcean Falls
Wed · 11:00 amWaterway Safety Committees in other waters Bella Coola

Start to learn from WSCs from other waters about different approaches, options, and lessons learned Objective 2

  • What is a WSC and why are we talking about one?
  • WSC panel discussion: How do WSCs operate in other waters? What have they achieved? What has not worked? What advice can be shared?
12:30 pm · Lunch (provided)Namu
Wed · 1:30 pmWhat would a successful CC-NVI WSC look like? Rivers Inlet

Start to build out considerations and suggestions for a CC-NVI WSC Objective 2

Breakout group discussions:

  • What do we need to consider for a CC-NVI WSC?
  • What should the WSC do – and not do? Why?
  • What would a highly successful WSC look like in 10 years?
  • Who is critical to this future success?
2:50 pm · Coffee breakPort Hardy
Wed · 3:10 pmDeveloping a WSC mission

Review and refine a draft mission statement and take stock of potential activities and participants Objective 2–3

  • Plenary report out from breakout groups
  • Review and refine draft mission statement
  • Identify potential future WSC activities to discuss tomorrow
Overnight · 4:00 pm adjournMinstrel Island
Thu · 9:00 amWelcome back

Recap and refine take-aways from Day 1 and revisit plan for Day 2

Thu · 9:15 amCC-NVI WSC Design Campbell River

Shape a vision for what a CC-NVI WSC will do, who will be involved, and how it will operate Objective 3

  • Who will be the members and in what capacity?
  • How will decisions be made?
10:30 am · Coffee breakQuathiaski Cove
Thu · 10:45 amPotential CC-NVI WSC priorities Cape Mudge

Using suggestions from Day 1, refine and prioritize ideas about what a WSC could do or produce Objective 3

12:00 pm · Lunch in the roomOyster River
Thu · 1:00 pmCharting the course for a WSC Comox

Conclude the workshop with clear plans for the next steps, including tasks, owners, and timing, plus a sense of who is ready to continue on the journey and how

  • Check back: do we have a shared mission?
  • Gaps: who is missing or what more information do we need, if any?
  • Determine specific next steps, owners, and timeline for establishing a WSC
  • Closing reflections
2:30 pm · AdjournJourney’s end
